observation: Lithium abolishes PTZ-induced seizure onset in Wwox-null mice
relation_hypothesised: The effect runs through GSK-3β inhibition
possible_action: Treat GSK-3β as a druggable node
favourable_reason: Report: strongest evidence of a druggable GSK-3β node
unfavourable_or_alternative: Lithium also inhibits IMPase/IPPase and both GSK-3 isoforms; inositol depletion converges on GSK-3; threshold not spontaneous seizures
discriminating_experiment: Arm panel with inositol-depletion mimic and S9A cross (C07)
reasoning_pattern: A non-selective drug effect is credited to one of its known targets without isolating that target

observation: GSK-3 inhibition raises nuclear β-catenin even with substrate-competitive peptide
relation_hypothesised: Inhibiting GSK-3β in WWOX models stabilizes β-catenin and worsens oligodendrocyte maturation and myelination
possible_action: Avoid or limit GSK-3β inhibition in development
context: Non-WWOX cells and cuprizone/OPC literature transferred to WWOX hypomyelination
benefit_to_verify: Myelin worsening by GSK-3β inhibition in Wwox-deficient animals
measured_or_inferred_per_step: obs=measured in other systems; relation=inferred; action=speculative
favourable_reason: Wnt activation intrinsic to the target; WWOX already hypomyelinated
unfavourable_or_alternative: Report admits harm is predicted not measured; EAE shows lithium can reduce demyelination in another setting
discriminating_experiment: COMPETING readouts (CC1, MBP, myelinated axons, Axin2) in every arm
reasoning_pattern: A liability documented in an unrelated system is transferred to the genotype by way of a shared node

observation: Reduced GSK-3β activity sustains progenitor proliferation (DISC1 system)
relation_hypothesised: GSK-3β inhibition perturbs neuronal maturation in WWOX deficiency
context: DISC1 neural progenitors transferred to WWOX models
unfavourable_or_alternative: No WWOX evidence; maturation deficit in WWOX asserted without source
reasoning_pattern: Same as C02: transfer by a shared node from a non-WWOX developmental system

observation: GSK-3β phosphorylates PI4KIIα and stabilizes synaptic NMDAR; CT99021 reduces NMDAR currents
relation_hypothesised: A β-catenin-independent GSK-3β branch carries the anti-excitability effect in WWOX cortex
possible_action: Target the substrate branch rather than the kinase
context: Non-WWOX synaptic preparations; WWOX layer II/III neurons with elevated EPSC
favourable_reason: Branch molecularly separable; KB gap flags unmapped intermediates
unfavourable_or_alternative: Report itself notes GSK3α (not β) in LTD, and branch may not carry WWOX effect
discriminating_experiment: CT99021 on Wwox-null L2/3 EPSC/NMDAR and PI4KIIα knockdown occlusion
reasoning_pattern: A mechanism from neighbouring physiology is transferred to the genotype by way of a shared kinase

observation: Substrate-competitive inhibitors allow fine-tuning; moderate inhibition favoured
relation_hypothesised: Partial GSK-3β inhibition raises seizure threshold while keeping β-catenin degraded
context: General kinase pharmacology applied to WWOX models
benefit_to_verify: A dose window separating benefit from harm
unfavourable_or_alternative: Differential sensitivity unmeasured and may be false
discriminating_experiment: Occupancy versus threshold versus β-catenin/Axin2 dose-response
reasoning_pattern: A threshold property of a pathway is assumed to leave a window between two outputs

observation: Adverse outputs are perinatal and developmental; seizures are chronic
relation_hypothesised: Dosing after the perinatal windows spares the harm and keeps the benefit
context: Neuronal Wwox-deletion mice; timing not sourced
favourable_reason: Windows said to be closed later
unfavourable_or_alternative: Assumes seizures persist and still respond; no timing evidence quoted
reasoning_pattern: A developmental liability is avoided by delaying exposure

observation: Lithium acts on both GSK-3 and inositol pathways
relation_hypothesised: Isolate on-target GSK-3β attribution by genetic and inositol-mimic controls
possible_action: S9A knock-in crossed to Wwox-null; inositol-depletion mimic arm
context: Mouse genetics; provoked and spontaneous seizures
unfavourable_or_alternative: Inositol inhibition itself inactivates GSK-3, so a mimic with no GSK-3 action may be unattainable; S9A abolishing rescue is asserted to prove attribution without analysis
reasoning_pattern: A genetic resistance allele is used to prove that a drug acts through its putative target

observation: Neonatal neuronal AAV9-WWOX rescues seizures, myelination, lethality
relation_hypothesised: Restoring WWOX bypasses the GSK-3β branch point without Wnt liability
favourable_reason: Only intervention shown to correct both in the same animals
unfavourable_or_alternative: Mechanism "restores the scaffold" is a reading
discriminating_experiment: AAV9-WWOX comparator arm quantifying GSK-3β strategy recovery
reasoning_pattern: Fixing the upstream defect is preferred over modulating a downstream node

relation_hypothesised: Context caveat: EAE benefit is immune-mediated and does not transfer to WWOX
unfavourable_or_alternative: The same finding can also mean GSK-3 inhibition is context-dependent, not necessarily harmful
reasoning_pattern: A favourable result in one system is explicitly not transferred to another

observation: Isoform selectivity of synaptic GSK3α in LTD and GSK-3β-specific S9A
relation_hypothesised: Isoform-selective drugs could separate synaptic from β-catenin outputs
possible_action: Medicinal chemistry of β-catenin-sparing GSK-3 tools
favourable_reason: Isoform specificity exists at the synapse
unfavourable_or_alternative: Report also states isoform selectivity cannot escape β-catenin harm (E16)
reasoning_pattern: A tool-level distinction in one preparation is carried to drug design for the genotype
